why: 通道有腕、手指、骨架分组但无逐轴语义。可以在原始向量分量上做无量纲轨迹比较，不把分量猜为xyz或四元数。腕向量+变化率比手指/全骨架更稳定，双向最大13帧；阶段标签仅按对应迁移。

channels.note: Names and units are source metadata; unspecified coordinate frames remain unknown. action is commanded data, observation.state is recorded state; sensor/vision-derived provenance must be checked before claiming sensor-only input.
